activity.title: Activity log
activity.subtitle: Audit trail of important actions
activity.emptyBody: Important actions (refunds, voids, settings changes) will appear here.

lockedFeature.deliveryNotAtThisBranch: {branch} does not deliver. Delivery is chosen branch by branch, so switching it on here adds riders, delivery fees and live tracking for this branch only.
lockedFeature.deliveryNotHere: This branch does not deliver. Delivery is chosen branch by branch, so switching it on here adds riders, delivery fees and live tracking for this branch only.
lockedFeature.deliveryUnlockedAtThisBranch: {branch} has delivery switched off. Delivery was unlocked here before, so switching it back on has no one-time fee — it only adds this branch's monthly price.
lockedFeature.deliveryUnlockedHere: Delivery is switched off at this branch. It was unlocked here before, so switching it back on has no one-time fee — it only adds this branch's monthly price.
